summary: Farming civ with strong defenses. English go either a two-Town-Center White Tower boom or Council Hall longbow pressure, and their farm bonus grows every age.
openings: 2 TC White Tower: Abbey of Kings with the king out around 5:00, a second Town Center about 6 tiles from the first with farms between, then Castle via the White Tower.
Council Hall longbow pressure: 5 longbows and 2 to 3 spears, pressuring until 10 to 11 minutes and reaching Castle around 12. Ten longbows kill villagers in one volley.

spikes.label: Longbow pressure
spikes.detail: With Council Hall they push with longbows and a few spears until about 11 minutes.
spikes.answer: Go full archers with a few spears. Don't answer longbows with cavalry.

spikes.label: Castle around 12
spikes.detail: The White Tower works like two stables for knights, and their farm bonus scales each age.
spikes.answer: Fast Castle, knight raids and Sacred Sites against the 2 TC boom. A White Tower that doesn't cover the farms leaves them raidable.

scout: Abbey of Kings and stone for a second Town Center mean the 2 TC White Tower boom

pairings.why: Against camel civs; cavalry against Macedonians.

winConditions.detail: A farm economy that scales into Imperial.
Relics and a big gold income in Castle.

howToBeat: Against a longbow rush go mass archers, not cavalry.
Against the 2 TC boom: fast Castle, knight raids and Sacred Sites.
Jeanne d'Arc players raid constantly with knights and deny the White Tower spot.
